summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 batches (SAFE-SOS-001, LOOKUP-SAFE-001, FREE-V1-001) on Expo web preview (390x844), logged in as voicetest2026@example.com. Code review + live UI testing confirms all 3 batches work as specified with no critical regressions. All tested emergency numbers render as plain/disabled text with the exact notice line; personal contacts (Trusted Circle, lost-passport embassy) remain code-unchanged/live; IPC-BNS lookup shows the new 'DHARA can't confirm this section yet/anymore' banner + Next step + working Ask DHARA CTA for an unapproved mapping (tested IPC 302) with no section number leaked; Pro-upgrade entry points are hidden everywhere checked and /upgrade shows the 'Pro isn't available in this version yet' placeholder with zero Stripe/Razorpay buttons rendered; free-tier drafts generation and 402 quota alert (no 'See Pro') both verified working end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Does not use the shared EmergencyNumberStatic/EmergencyNotActiveNotice component. The circle is correctly a non-interactive View (not Pressable) and is visually disabled, but the required exact notice sentence 'Emergency calling is not active in this test version. Dial 112 on your phone if you need help.' is split across two separate Text nodes ('Not active in this test version' on the circle + 'Dial 112 on your phone if you need help.' below) instead of appearing verbatim as one string. Functionally safe (no tel: link) but does not match the exact-copy requirement from the batch spec.

action_items: LOW: Update app/emergency.tsx to render the exact single-string notice ('Emergency calling is not active in this test version. Dial 112 on your phone if you need help.') via EmergencyNotActiveNotice, consistent with every other screen, instead of the current two-fragment text.

INFO ONLY — not a regression from these 3 batches: /visitor/intent, /visitor/emergency, and /visitor/lost-passport all show an infinite ActivityIndicator when navigated to directly, because they call loadVisitorSession() which returns null until a visitor session is created via the proper visitor-mode entry flow (not reachable by direct URL in this preview). Code for these screens (EmergencyNumberStatic usage, embassy call button) is correctly unchanged per SAFE-SOS-001 scope, but live UI confirmation of the specific tel: numbers/embassy button on these 3 screens could not be completed — recommend finding/using the real visitor-mode entry route to confirm visually.

INFO ONLY: Trusted Circle screen had zero saved contacts in this account, so the live circle-call-<id> button could not be visually exercised (code review at women/trusted-circle.tsx:138 confirms it still calls openPhone(ct.phone), unchanged — no code modification needed).
critical_code_review_comments: EmergencyNumberStatic.tsx / EmergencyNotActiveNotice correctly implemented as plain View/Text, never Pressable, never calls openExternal/openPhone — used consistently across action-plan, fraud-checklist, women/nearest-help, women/officer-card, missing/index, missing/result, (tabs)/index SOS banner + emergency-call-shortcut, SOSButton modal, visitor/intent, visitor/emergency, women-shield, src/women/PrivacyCover.

Personal/live call paths correctly left untouched: women/trusted-circle.tsx (openPhone), visitor/lost-passport.tsx embassy button (openExternal(tel:)), app/alerts/[id].tsx guardian/alert-owner call (openExternal(tel:)) — none route through EmergencyNumberStatic, matching the intentional scope exclusion.

ipc-bns-lookup.tsx NotYetApprovedBanner correctly differentiates 'revoked' vs other non-approved reasons with distinct copy, includes the required Next-step line, and the Ask DHARA Pressable correctly stopPropagation()s so it doesn't also trigger the card's own expand/collapse onPress. Guard E/defense-in-depth comments confirm offence/new_section can never render when isWithheld is true.

FREE-V1-001 gating is implemented via a single `PRO_UPGRADE_ENABLED = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_PRO_UPGRADE_ENABLED === 'true'` constant repeated consistently in upgrade.tsx, (tabs)/index.tsx, settings.tsx, drafts/[type].tsx, drafts/index.tsx — all payment code/hooks remain intact underneath the flag (not deleted), satisfying the 'easy to re-enable later' requirement.

drafts/[type].tsx onGenerate() correctly short-circuits to a single-button 'OK' alert with no router.push('/upgrade') when PRO_UPGRADE_ENABLED is false, before ever reaching the Platform.OS==='web' confirm()/crossAlert 'See Pro' branch.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all critical SAFE-SOS-001/LOOKUP-SAFE-001/FREE-V1-001 flows verified passing; 1 low-priority copy deviation on /emergency; 3 visitor-mode screens unreachable via direct URL in web preview (pre-existing session-gate limitation, not a regression)

seed_data_creation: None created. Used existing voicetest2026@example.com account; consumed its 1 free draft quota via normal app usage (cheque_bounce demand notice x2, triggering the expected 402 'Free notice used' alert) — no persistent TEST_ records added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 batches (SAFE-SOS-001, LOOKUP-SAFE-001, FREE-V1-001) verified functionally correct via live Expo web preview + code review. Only finding is a cosmetic exact-copy deviation on /emergency.tsx's big-112-circle screen (uses two separate Text fragments instead of the single EmergencyNotActiveNotice string) — low priority, main agent can fix trivially by swapping in the shared component. Visitor-mode screens (/visitor/intent, /visitor/emergency, /visitor/lost-passport) could not be visually confirmed in this run because they gate on an AsyncStorage visitor session that direct URL navigation never creates — this is pre-existing session-gating logic untouched by these 3 batches, not a new defect; a future agent with access to the real visitor-mode entry point (QR/deep-link for non-account users) should do a final visual pass on those 3 screens specifically for the embassy-call regression check and the 112/1098 EmergencyNumberStatic rendering.
